arStrings.szText:
You automatically link yourself with up to {c_number}{SF_3}{/c} surrounding monsters. When you take damage, you deal {c_random}[{SF_4}*100|0%|]{/c} of it to your linked targets.{if:SF_2}

Using a {c_important}Defensive{/c}, {c_important}Macabre{/c} or {c_important}Subterfuge{/c} Skill converts this linked damage into guaranteed Critical Strikes for {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} seconds.{/if}
Purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
Using a {c_important}Defensive{/c}, {c_important}Macabre{/c} or {c_important}Subterfuge{/c} Skill converts the linked damage into guaranteed Critical Strikes for {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} seconds.
